text: 天孚通信公告，控股股东苏州天孚仁和投资管理有限公司提议公司以自有或自筹资金通过集中竞价交易方式回购股份，回购资金总额不低于人民币1亿元（含）且不超过人民币1.5亿元（含），回购价格上限为人民币350元/股（含）。回购股份拟全部注销并减少公司注册资本，回购期限为股东会审议通过回购方案之日起六个月内。
text_en: Tianfu Communication announced that controlling shareholder Suzhou Tianfu Renhe Investment Management Co., Ltd. proposed that the company repurchase shares through centralized bidding transactions using its own funds or self-raised funds, with the total repurchase amount no less than RMB 100 million (inclusive) and no more than RMB 150 million (inclusive), and a maximum repurchase price of RMB 350 per share (inclusive). The repurchased shares are intended to be fully cancelled and reduce the company's registered capital, and the repurchase period is within six months from the date the shareholders' meeting approves the repurchase plan.
